chunks: After this We told the children of Israel: 'Dwell in the land. When the promise of reckoning comes, We shall bring you together from a motley crowd.'

key_terms.وَعْدُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ: the promise of the last/final reckoning

ai.seo_question: What did God command the Children of Israel to do regarding the earth, and what happens when the final promise comes?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the promise of the final gathering of humanity, with 'lafifan' (crowded together) signifying the inevitable assembly for judgment. It serves as a bridge between the historical settlement of the Israelites and the eschatological reality where all souls are brought forth for accountability, reflecting the divine justice emphasized in the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings.
